lessons.text: Prepare an answer before you assert: Carl Friedrich Gauss broke through with "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. When the measured results are compared across studies, then the pattern i…" (Clean argument. structure=1.00, evidence=0.50).

Your winning pattern: "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. The research found the effect repeatedly; since the premise survives test…" — it answered the opponent directly, it carried evidence, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.
Never use appeal to ignorance (Treating the absence of disproof as proof (or the reverse)). It cost you against Segenet Kelemu.
